name: Overnight Oats with Blueberries & Walnuts
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt and chia together in a jar
Refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours)
Top with blueberries, chopped walnuts and honey before eating

name: Spinach & Feta Scramble on Toast
steps: Warm olive oil in a non-stick pan and wilt the spinach
Add beaten eggs and stir gently over low heat until just set
Fold in crumbled feta
Serve on toasted bread with sliced tomato

name: Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl
Top with sliced strawberries, oats, chopped almonds and flaxseed
Drizzle with honey

name: Savory Oats with Egg & Kale
steps: Simmer oats in broth for 5 minutes, stirring
Stir in finely chopped kale for the last 2 minutes
Fry the eggs in olive oil
Serve oats topped with eggs and grated parmesan

name: Turmeric Tofu Veggie Scramble
steps: Saute diced onion and pepper in olive oil for 4 minutes
Crumble in the tofu with turmeric and cook 5 minutes
Fold in spinach until wilted
Serve with toast

name: Banana Peanut Butter Oatmeal
steps: Simmer oats in milk for 5 minutes
Stir in cinnamon and half the mashed banana
Top with remaining sliced banana and peanut butter

name: Cottage Cheese Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend cottage cheese, eggs and oats into a smooth batter
Cook small pancakes in a lightly buttered pan, 2 minutes per side
Serve with raspberries and maple syrup

name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion, pepper and garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes
Add spices and tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes
Make wells and crack in the eggs
Cover and cook until whites are set
Garnish with parsley and serve with bread

name: Pan-Seared Salmon Avocado Toast
steps: Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip and cook 2 more
Mash avocado with lemon juice
Spread on toast and top with flaked salmon and arugula

name: Berry Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk chia seeds into milk and maple syrup
Refrigerate at least 4 hours, stirring once
Layer with yogurt and thawed berries
Top with pumpkin seeds

name: Egg & Black Bean Breakfast Burrito
steps: Saute diced pepper 3 minutes
Add eggs and whites and scramble until set
Warm beans
Fill the tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese, avocado and diced tomato and roll

name: Buckwheat Apple Cinnamon Porridge
steps: Rinse buckwheat and simmer in milk for 15 minutes until tender
Stir in grated apple and cinnamon
Serve topped with yogurt and walnuts

name: Mango Quinoa Breakfast Bowl
steps: Rinse quinoa and simmer in milk for 15 minutes
Let stand 2 minutes
Top with yogurt, diced mango and hemp seeds

name: Ricotta Pear & Walnut Toast
steps: Toast the bread
Spread with ricotta
Top with thinly sliced pear and walnuts
Drizzle with honey

name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Simmer tomatoes, onion and cumin into a quick salsa
Warm the beans and fry the eggs
Layer tortilla, beans and eggs
Spoon over salsa and top with avocado, cilantro and lime

name: Tamago Rice Bowl with Edamame
steps: Cook the rice
Whisk eggs with half the soy sauce and cook as a thin rolled omelette
Blanch spinach and edamame
Serve over rice with spring onion, sesame oil and remaining soy sauce

name: Mediterranean Egg Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 180 C and oil a muffin tin
Dice vegetables and divide between cups
Whisk eggs, whites and feta and pour over
Bake 18-20 minutes
Serve with toast

name: Kiwi Citrus Yogurt Bowl
steps: Peel and slice kiwi and orange
Spoon yogurt into a bowl and add fruit
Top with oats, almonds and honey

name: Sweet Potato Hash with Eggs
steps: Dice sweet potato and cook in olive oil, covered, 10 minutes
Add onion, pepper and paprika and cook 5 minutes
Stir in kale
Make two wells, crack in eggs and cover until set

name: Turkish Menemen
steps: Saute onion and pepper in olive oil 5 minutes
Add grated tomato and chili flakes and cook until jammy
Stir in beaten eggs until softly set
Serve with bread

name: Blueberry Banana Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend oats, eggs, whites and banana
Fold in half the blueberries
Cook pancakes in a non-stick pan 2 minutes per side
Top with yogurt, remaining berries and maple syrup

name: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oats
steps: Heat oven to 180 C
Mix oats, milk, egg, cinnamon and diced apple in a small dish
Top with walnuts and bake 25 minutes
Serve with yogurt

name: Cottage Cheese Pomegranate Kiwi Bowl
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl
Top with pomegranate seeds, sliced kiwi and oats
Finish with pumpkin seeds and honey

name: Smoky Black Bean Toast with Egg
steps: Mash beans with paprika and lime and warm through
Fry or poach the egg
Spread beans on toast, add sliced avocado and tomato and top with the egg

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast & Yogurt
steps: Toast bread and spread with peanut butter
Top with sliced banana and cinnamon
Serve with yogurt on the side

name: Miso Breakfast Soup with Tofu & Egg
steps: Cook the rice
Heat broth to a simmer, add cubed tofu and spinach
Swirl in the beaten egg
Off the heat whisk in miso
Serve with rice and spring onion

name: Chocolate Cherry Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats, milk, cocoa, yogurt and maple syrup
Refrigerate overnight
Top with pitted cherries and almonds

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Chickpea Salad
steps: Simmer quinoa 15 minutes and cool
Dice cucumber, tomato and onion
Toss everything with lemon juice and olive oil
Top with crumbled feta, olives and parsley

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps: Cook rice
Season chicken with cumin and sear in olive oil 6 minutes per side, then slice
Saute pepper and corn
Warm beans
Assemble bowls and top with avocado, cilantro and lime

name: Roasted Squash & Lentil Salad
steps: Roast cubed squash with half the oil at 200 C for 25 minutes
Simmer lentils 20 minutes and drain
Toss lentils, squash and arugula with balsamic and remaining oil
Top with feta and walnuts

name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
steps: Boil potatoes 15 minutes, adding green beans for the last 4
Boil eggs 8 minutes and halve
Whisk oil, mustard and lemon
Arrange lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomato, tuna, eggs and olives and dress

name: Seared Salmon Poke Bowl
steps: Cook rice
Sear salmon 3 minutes per side and flake
Blanch edamame
Julienne carrot and cucumber
Assemble bowls and dress with soy sauce and sesame oil

name: Turkey Hummus Wraps
steps: Brown turkey with paprika in olive oil 8 minutes
Spread tortillas with hummus
Fill with turkey, spinach, sliced pepper and cucumber
Roll tightly and halve

name: Greek Chicken Pita Bowl
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, oregano, garlic and oil
Grill 6 minutes per side and slice
Grate half the cucumber into yogurt for tzatziki
Serve chicken with chopped salad, tzatziki and warm bread

name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Quesadillas
steps: Steam or microwave diced sweet potato until soft and mash with cumin
Spread on tortillas with beans, spinach and cheese
Fold and toast in a dry pan 3 minutes per side
Serve with chopped tomato

name: Peanut Tofu Noodle Salad
steps: Soak noodles per packet and rinse cold
Pan-fry cubed tofu until golden
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime, grated ginger and a splash of water
Toss noodles, shredded cabbage, carrot, edamame and tofu with the dressing
Top with cilantro

name: Egg & Avocado Grain Bowl
steps: Cook rice
Soft-boil eggs 7 minutes
Massage kale with lemon and oil
Assemble rice, kale, chickpeas, tomato and avocado
Top with halved eggs and pumpkin seeds

name: Hearty Lentil & Spinach Soup
steps: Soften onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil 8 minutes
Add cumin, lentils, tomatoes and broth
Simmer 25 minutes
Stir in spinach until wilted
Serve with bread

name: Chicken Kale Caesar (Yogurt Dressing)
steps: Grill chicken and slice
Cube bread, toss with oil and toast into croutons
Whisk yogurt, lemon, mustard, garlic and half the parmesan
Massage kale with dressing
Top with chicken, croutons and remaining parmesan

name: Shrimp & Mango Rice Salad
steps: Cook rice and cool
Saute shrimp in olive oil 2 minutes per side
Dice mango, pepper and cucumber
Toss all with lime juice, chili and cilantro
Top with cashews

name: Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowl
steps: Cook rice
Slice beef thinly and sear in sesame oil 2 minutes
Add broccoli, garlic and ginger and stir-fry 4 minutes
Add soy sauce and honey and toss
Serve over rice with spring onion

name: Baked Falafel-Style Chickpea Bowl
steps: Pulse chickpeas with parsley, cumin and oil and form patties
Bake at 200 C for 20 minutes
Cook quinoa
Whisk tahini, lemon and yogurt
Serve with chopped cucumber, tomato and cabbage

name: Sardine & White Bean Salad
steps: Rinse beans
Thinly slice onion and soak in lemon juice
Toss beans, arugula, tomato, onion and parsley with oil
Top with sardines and serve with bread

name: White Bean Minestrone
steps: Soften onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil
Add tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes
Add pasta, zucchini and beans and cook 10 minutes
Stir in kale
Serve with parmesan

name: Chicken, Leek & Barley Soup
steps: Brown chicken in oil and set aside
Soften onion, leek, carrot and celery
Add barley, broth and chicken and simmer 35 minutes
Shred chicken back in and finish with parsley

name: Tofu Banh Mi Bowl
steps: Cook rice
Press and slice tofu and pan-fry with soy sauce until crisp
Quick-pickle carrot and cabbage in lime juice
Assemble with cucumber, chili, spring onion and cilantro

name: Loaded Sweet Potatoes with Cottage Cheese
steps: Bake sweet potatoes at 200 C for 40 minutes
Warm beans with spinach, oil and paprika
Split potatoes and fill with beans and cottage cheese
Top with spring onion

name: Tuna & White Bean Pasta Salad
steps: Cook pasta and rinse cold
Toss with tuna, beans, tomato, olives and arugula
Dress with oil and lemon and finish with basil

name: Moroccan Chickpea Carrot Salad
steps: Cook quinoa and cool
Grate carrots
Whisk lemon, oil, cumin and cinnamon
Toss quinoa, chickpeas, carrot, raisins and parsley with the dressing
Top with toasted almonds and serve with yogurt

name: Egg Fried Brown Rice with Peas
steps: Cook rice and spread to cool
Scramble eggs in half the sesame oil and set aside
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, carrot, peas and edamame 4 minutes
Add rice, eggs and soy sauce and toss until hot
Finish with spring onion

name: Spicy Red Lentil Dal
steps: Cook rice
Soften onion, garlic and ginger
Add spices and toast 1 minute
Add lentils, tomatoes and 600 ml water and simmer 20 minutes
Stir in coconut milk and spinach
Finish with lime

name: Chicken Shawarma Salad
steps: Rub chicken with spices and oil and roast at 210 C for 25 minutes
Slice
Whisk tahini with lemon and water
Toss lettuce, tomato, cucumber and onion
Top with chicken and tahini and serve with bread

name: Pumpkin & Feta Barley Risotto
steps: Soften onion and garlic in oil
Add barley and diced squash
Add broth gradually and simmer 35 minutes, stirring
Fold in spinach and white beans
Top with feta and pumpkin seeds

name: Mackerel, Beetroot & Potato Salad
steps: Boil potatoes and beetroot until tender and slice
Grill mackerel 3 minutes per side
Whisk yogurt, mustard and lemon
Arrange arugula, potatoes and beetroot, flake over mackerel and dress

name: Spring Asparagus, Pea & Egg Salad
steps: Boil potatoes 15 minutes
Blanch asparagus and peas 3 minutes
Boil eggs 8 minutes
Toss vegetables with arugula, lemon and oil
Top with eggs and shaved parmesan

name: Gazpacho with Chickpeas & Eggs
steps: Blend tomato, most of the cucumber, pepper, onion, garlic and oil until smooth
Chill at least 1 hour
Boil eggs 9 minutes
Serve topped with chickpeas, chopped egg and diced cucumber with bread

name: Pork & Apple Rice Lettuce Cups
steps: Cook rice
Dice pork and stir-fry with ginger 6 minutes
Add diced apple, carrot and soy sauce for 2 minutes
Spoon rice and pork into lettuce leaves
Finish with lime and spring onion

name: Baked Salmon with Sweet Potato & Broccoli
steps: Roast cubed sweet potato with half the oil at 200 C for 15 minutes
Add broccoli and salmon brushed with garlic, lemon and remaining oil
Roast 12-15 minutes more until salmon flakes

name: Turkey Bean Chili
steps: Brown turkey with onion, pepper and garlic
Add spices and toast 1 minute
Add tomatoes and beans and simmer 25 minutes
Serve over rice with a spoon of yogurt

name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
steps: Cook rice
Slice chicken and stir-fry in sesame oil 5 minutes
Add vegetables, garlic and ginger and cook 4 minutes
Add soy sauce and toss
Serve over rice

name: Lean Beef Bolognese
steps: Soften finely diced onion, carrot and celery in oil
Brown the beef with garlic
Add tomato paste and tomatoes and simmer 30 minutes
Cook pasta
Toss and serve with parmesan and basil

name: Coconut Chicken Curry
steps: Cook rice
Fry garlic, ginger, chili and curry powder 1 minute
Add diced chicken and brown
Add coconut milk and vegetables and simmer 15 minutes
Finish with lime and cilantro

name: Lemon Herb Cod with Quinoa & Asparagus
steps: Cook quinoa
Roast asparagus and tomato with half the oil at 200 C for 10 minutes
Add cod brushed with garlic, lemon and oil and roast 10 minutes
Stir parsley and lemon zest through the quinoa and serve

name: Chickpea Spinach Curry
steps: Cook rice
Soften onion, garlic and ginger
Add curry powder, tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes
Stir in coconut milk and spinach
Serve with rice and yogurt

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apples & Brussels Sprouts
steps: Roast halved potatoes with oil at 200 C for 15 minutes
Add sprouts and apple wedges
Brush pork with mustard, sear and add to the tray
Roast 20 minutes until pork reaches 63 C and rest 5 minutes

name: Shrimp & Zucchini Whole Wheat Linguine
steps: Cook pasta
Saute garlic and chili in oil
Add zucchini and tomato for 4 minutes
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes
Toss with pasta, spinach, lemon and parsley

name: Peanut Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Soak noodles
Crisp cubed tofu in sesame oil
Stir-fry vegetables with garlic and ginger 5 minutes
Whisk peanut butter, soy, lime and water
Toss noodles, tofu and sauce together

name: Turkey & Quinoa Stuffed Peppers
steps: Cook quinoa
Brown turkey with onion, garlic and cumin
Stir in tomatoes, spinach and quinoa
Fill halved peppers and top with mozzarella
Bake at 190 C for 25 minutes

name: Moroccan Chicken & Chickpea Tagine
steps: Brown chicken
Soften onion and ginger with the spices
Add carrots, tomatoes, chickpeas, raisins, broth and chicken
Simmer covered 30 minutes
Serve over quinoa with parsley

name: Beef & Barley Stew
steps: Brown cubed beef in batches
Soften onion, celery and garlic
Add tomato paste, barley, broth, carrot, potato and beef
Simmer covered 70 minutes until tender
Finish with parsley

name: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Greens
steps: Cook rice
Mix miso, honey and soy and brush on salmon
Broil 8-10 minutes
Saute spinach and edamame with ginger in sesame oil
Serve with rice and spring onion

name: Lentil & Mushroom Bolognese
steps: Soften onion, carrot, celery and garlic
Add chopped mushrooms and cook until browned
Add lentils, tomato paste, tomatoes and 400 ml water and simmer 30 minutes
Cook pasta and serve with parmesan

name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss sliced chicken, peppers and onion with spices and oil
Roast at 220 C for 20 minutes
Warm tortillas
Fill with chicken and vegetables, avocado, yogurt, lime and cilantro

name: Mushroom & White Bean Risotto
steps: Brown mushrooms in oil
Soften onion and garlic
Toast rice 1 minute
Add hot broth a ladle at a time for 18 minutes, stirring
Fold in beans, spinach, mushrooms, butter and parmesan

name: Baked Cod with Tomatoes & Olives
steps: Roast sliced potatoes with half the oil at 200 C for 20 minutes
Add tomato, onion, garlic and olives
Nestle in cod and roast 12 minutes
Finish with lemon and parsley

name: Black Bean Tacos with Mango Salsa
steps: Warm beans with cumin and lightly mash
Dice mango, onion and cilantro with lime for salsa
Shred cabbage
Fill warm tortillas with beans, cabbage, salsa, avocado and feta

name: Herbed Chicken Ratatouille
steps: Saute onion and garlic
Add diced eggplant, pepper and zucchini and cook 10 minutes
Add tomato and simmer 20 minutes
Grill chicken and slice
Cook quinoa
Serve topped with basil

name: Butternut Squash & Red Lentil Curry
steps: Cook rice
Soften onion, garlic and ginger
Add curry powder, squash, lentils and 600 ml water
Simmer 20 minutes
Stir in coconut milk and spinach
Garnish with cilantro and serve with yogurt

name: Mustard Herb Pork with Root Vegetables
steps: Roast chopped carrot, beetroot and sweet potato with oil at 200 C for 20 minutes
Coat pork in mustard, garlic and parsley
Add to the tray and roast 20 minutes
Rest and slice

name: Salmon & Kale Pesto Pasta
steps: Cook pasta
Blanch kale 2 minutes
Blend kale, basil, walnuts, parmesan, garlic, oil and lemon into pesto
Pan-sear salmon and flake
Toss pasta with pesto and salmon

name: Korean-Style Beef Rice Bowls
steps: Cook rice
Brown beef with garlic and ginger
Add soy sauce, honey and chili flakes and reduce
Julienne carrot and cucumber
Serve beef over rice with vegetables, lettuce, sesame oil and spring onion

name: Cauliflower & Chickpea Tikka
steps: Toss cauliflower in half the yogurt and curry powder and roast at 220 C for 25 minutes
Simmer onion, garlic, ginger, remaining spice, tomatoes and chickpeas 15 minutes
Stir in cauliflower and remaining yogurt off the heat
Serve with rice and cilantro

name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Brown chicken in oil
Saute onion, pepper, mushrooms and garlic
Add tomatoes, olives and chicken and simmer 30 minutes
Serve over pasta with basil

name: Grilled Mackerel with Lentils & Leeks
steps: Simmer lentils 20 minutes
Soften sliced leek and carrot in oil, add kale
Stir in lentils, mustard and lemon
Grill mackerel 3 minutes per side and serve on top with parsley

name: Eggplant Parmigiana with Lentils
steps: Slice and roast eggplant with oil at 200 C for 20 minutes
Simmer onion, garlic, tomatoes and lentils with 300 ml water for 20 minutes
Layer eggplant, sauce and mozzarella
Top with parmesan and bake 25 minutes
Finish with basil

name: Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini & Rice
steps: Cook rice
Mix turkey, egg, oats, half the garlic and parmesan and roll meatballs
Brown in oil
Add onion, remaining garlic, tomatoes and diced zucchini and simmer 20 minutes
Serve over rice with basil

name: Shrimp & Sweetcorn Summer Skillet
steps: Cook quinoa
Saute corn, pepper and zucchini 5 minutes
Add garlic, paprika, shrimp and tomato and cook 4 minutes
Finish with lime and cilantro and serve over quinoa

name: Roast Chicken Thighs with Sprouts & Potatoes
steps: Toss halved potatoes and sprouts with oil and garlic
Rub chicken with mustard and lemon
Roast everything at 210 C for 35 minutes
Finish with parsley

name: Japanese Tofu Curry
steps: Cook rice
Soften onion
Add curry powder, potato, carrot, grated apple and broth and simmer 20 minutes
Add cubed tofu, peas and soy sauce for 5 minutes
Serve with rice

name: Greek Yogurt with Walnuts & Honey
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl
Top with walnuts and honey

name: Apple with Almond Butter
steps: Slice the apple
Serve with almond butter for dipping

name: Hummus & Veggie Sticks
steps: Cut vegetables into sticks
Serve with hummus

name: Boiled Eggs with Tomatoes
steps: Boil eggs 9 minutes and cool
Serve with sliced tomato and bread

name: Cottage Cheese with Strawberries
steps: Top cottage cheese with sliced strawberries and pumpkin seeds

name: Climber's Trail Mix
steps: Combine nuts, seeds, raisins and chopped chocolate
Portion into a small container

name: Banana, Peanut Butter & Milk
steps: Slice banana and top with peanut butter
Serve with a glass of milk

name: Chili Lime Edamame
steps: Boil edamame 4 minutes and drain
Toss with lime juice and chili flakes

name: Tuna Cucumber Bites
steps: Mix tuna with yogurt and lemon
Slice cucumber into thick rounds
Spoon tuna on top

name: Chocolate Raspberry Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk chia, cocoa and maple syrup into milk
Refrigerate 4 hours
Top with raspberries

name: Roasted Spiced Chickpeas
steps: Pat chickpeas dry
Toss with oil and spices
Roast at 200 C for 25 minutes until crisp

name: Kiwi & Orange Vitamin C Yogurt Cup
steps: Peel and dice kiwi and orange
Layer with yogurt (a vitamin C rich snack 30-60 minutes before training)

name: Almond Butter Stuffed Dates & Milk
steps: Pit dates and fill with almond butter
Serve with a glass of milk

name: Ricotta Blueberry Toast
steps: Toast bread
Spread ricotta and top with blueberries and honey

name: Peanut Butter Oat Energy Balls
steps: Blend dates until sticky
Mix in oats, peanut butter, flax and cocoa
Roll into 4 balls and chill

name: Mozzarella, Tomato & Basil Plate
steps: Slice mozzarella and tomato
Arrange with basil and drizzle with oil
Serve with bread

name: Pear, Cheddar & Walnuts
steps: Slice pear and cheddar
Serve with walnuts

name: Cherry Recovery Smoothie
steps: Pit cherries
Blend all ingredients until smooth

name: Green Mango Smoothie
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth
Serve immediately

name: Sardines on Toast
steps: Toast bread
Top with sliced tomato and sardines
Squeeze over lemon

name: Orange & Pumpkin Seeds
steps: Peel and segment the orange
Serve with pumpkin seeds

name: Frozen Berry Hemp Yogurt Bowl
steps: Thaw berries briefly
Stir into yogurt and top with hemp seeds

name: Quick Miso Tofu Soup
steps: Simmer broth with cubed tofu and spinach 3 minutes
Off the heat whisk in miso
Top with spring onion
